authorization: User requires Elm GUI and Haskell backend, with current EARS/OpenSpec aligned to the design

changes.before: The Elm desktop SHALL assign DOM presentation to Elm, Wayland surface lifetime to the native host, and application-window effects to native authority.
changes.after: The Elm desktop SHALL assign DOM presentation and all GUI elements to Elm, Wayland surface lifetime and backend/native host integration to Haskell, and application-window effects to one Haskell-owned native authority.
changes.classification: Explicit implementation-language/ownership revision; original scenario verification and behavior retained

changes.before: The release builder SHALL pin compiler, Elm packages, test runner, JavaScript adapter, native dependencies and build-tool versions with source and artifact hashes.
changes.after: The release builder SHALL pin Elm and Haskell compilers and packages, test runner, Haskell host and transport adapters, approved native dependencies and build-tool versions with source and artifact hashes.
changes.classification: Explicit implementation-language/ownership revision; original scenario verification and behavior retained

changes.before: WHEN a privileged operation requires authorization, the shell SHALL delegate to the established native authorization flow and keep credentials outside Elm and JavaScript.
changes.after: WHEN a privileged operation requires authorization, the shell SHALL delegate to the established native authorization flow and keep credentials outside Elm state and all frontend messages.
changes.classification: Explicit implementation-language/ownership revision; original scenario verification and behavior retained

changes.before: WHERE a compositor replacement is selected, the project SHALL document a native Rust or C++ execution boundary and an Elm policy interface before implementation.
changes.after: WHERE a compositor replacement is selected, the project SHALL document a Haskell native execution boundary and an Elm GUI and typed policy interface before implementation.
changes.classification: Explicit implementation language/ownership revision; behavioral verification remains unchanged

changes.before: The Elm host adapter SHALL keep JavaScript limited to validated transport and approved host integrations, keep GPU resources and per-frame work outside Elm messages and use current commands and subscriptions rather than historical Signal APIs.
changes.after: The Elm host adapter SHALL use validated Haskell transport and approved host integrations, keep GPU resources and per-frame work outside Elm messages and use current commands and subscriptions rather than historical Signal APIs.
changes.classification: Explicit implementation language/ownership revision; behavioral verification remains unchanged
